Jordan / team —

On the rollout/canary ask: after chatting with infra, the earliest safe canary window is May 3 — that gives engineering two sprints to bake the metrics and fallback. Proposed plan (added to matrix):

- Canary target: 10% traffic, 72-hour observation window
- Success metrics: p95 latency <= 220ms, error rate < 0.2%, no regressions on top-100 prompt evals
- Rollback criteria: any sustained error spike >0.5% or degradation in average quality score >3%

I've assigned owners for the metric dashboards and will push a lightweight dashboard link into the shared folder. Also: small ask for Acme — we need a sample prompt corpus (10 representative prompts) for sanity checks. Alice, can you share that by Friday?

Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Solutions
Redwood Inference
